[link preview]Resolution criteria

This market resolves to YES if Andrew Tate is physically detained in a jail, prison, or correctional holding facility continuously (or being transferred) in any jurisdiction (including the United States, the United Kingdom, Romania, or elsewhere) at 11:59 PM Eastern Time (ET) on August 31, 2026.

This market resolves to NO if he has been released from physical custody at any point in that time.

"Released" includes being let out on bail, bond, personal recognizance, or having the extradition warrant/charges dismissed.

Being placed under house arrest, monitored by an ankle bracelet, or subjected to travel restrictions without being physically confined to a detention facility or jail will resolve to NO.

Resolution will be determined using credible, mainstream media reports (e.g., AP News, Reuters, BBC, TMZ) or official court/inmate records.

Background

On July 18, 2026, Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan were arrested by U.S. Marshals outside an event venue in Miami, Florida. The arrest was carried out on behalf of a UK extradition request following newly authorized charges by the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS). These expanded charges against Andrew Tate include seven counts of rape, three counts of arranging or facilitating trafficking for sexual exploitation, three counts of assault, and 19 charges relating to indecent images of a child and extreme pornography.

The brothers, who are dual U.S.-British citizens, had arrived in Florida in February 2025 after Romanian prosecutors permitted them to leave Romania while awaiting trial there. They now face potential extradition proceedings in U.S. federal court to be returned to the UK.

[CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/27/us/andrew-tate-tristan-bail-us-latam-intl) (I used this page only for the arrest background. It is dated after the cutoff, so nothing else from it is used here.)

- 2026-08-13: Magistrate Judge Lauren Louis moved the detention hearing from Thursday, August 13 to **August 27**. The defense asked for the delay because it needed more time to respond to prosecutors. [Local10/AP](https://local10.com/news/2026/08/13/judge-postpones-hearing-over-whether-tate-brothers-should-stay-in-custody-as-they-fight-extradition); [Irish Examiner](https://www.irishexaminer.com/world/arid-41895469.html); [PBS](https://pbs.org/newshour/nation/judge-postpones-hearing-over-whether-tate-brothers-should-stay-in-custody-as-they-fight-extradition)

No extradition hearing date has been set, and AP said the brothers "could spend months in detention." - Early August 2026 (exact date not confirmed): AP reported that U.S. prosecutors want the brothers kept in custody during the extradition fight. [NBC Miami](https://nbcmiami.com/news/local/prosecutors-want-tate-brothers-to-remain-in-custody-as-they-fight-extradition-to-uk/3844275); [The Journal](https://www.the-journal.com/?p=155773)
- The UK charges against Andrew include rape, trafficking for sexual exploitation, assault, and indecent images and extreme pornography offences, as described in the question.

## 4. Base rates
- Under U.S. extradition law there is a strong presumption against bail. A defendant must show "special circumstances" as well as no flight risk and no danger to the community. AP's August 13 report notes this presumption. [Local10/AP](https://local10.com/news/2026/08/13/judge-postpones-hearing-over-whether-tate-brothers-should-stay-in-custody-as-they-fight-extradition)
- Bail in U.S. extradition cases is generally granted rarely. I found no quantitative base rate.
- For comparison, the Tates were held in Romania for about three months (December 2022 to March 2023) before moving to house arrest. That history is well known; I did not re-check it in this session.
- Timing: even if bail is granted at or soon after the August 27 hearing, release before August 31 could be delayed by the time needed to write a ruling and set conditions, or by a possible government appeal.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I could not find a Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on whether Tate is in jail at the end of August, or any price for one.
- Related: a Manifold market on whether Andrew Tate spends more than a year in prison before 2027 was reported at about 2% as of 2026-07-20. That is a different question. [tech-insider](https://tech-insider.org/andrew-tate-prison-2027-manifold-market-odds-arrest/)
- Older Polymarket markets on whether either brother would be arrested by a given date (March 31, April 30, June 30) are not relevant now. [simplefunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/either-tate-brother-arrested-by-june-30-polymarket-0x5005adaac0)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **2026-08-27: detention (bail) hearing** before Magistrate Judge Lauren Louis in Miami. This is the main event that could move the outcome. The judge might rule from the bench or take the matter under advisement. If she does not rule before August 31, he stays in custody by default.
- If bail is granted, the government could appeal or ask for a stay, and the bail conditions would have to be put in place before he is actually released.
- Mid-September 2026 (after the resolution date): deadline for the UK's formal extradition package.
- Romania: the Tates also face a separate Romanian case. Any Romanian court action is unlikely to affect U.S. custody before August 31.
